published_implementation.historical_relation: The pinned v4-flash-factorial repository invokes the public Claude Code CLI through its native non-interactive agent loop against llama.cpp's Anthropic Messages endpoint without a translation shim. The exact upstream Claude Code package version or repository revision used for the published cells is not exposed; the canonical review ref above is an identity-linkage snapshot, not the evaluated runtime revision.

result.model_config: unsloth/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731-GGUF UD-Q8_K_XL; llama-server; ctx_size=262144; temperature=0.6; top_p=0.95; seed=0; max_tokens=32000; same 30-task order; default reasoning behavior; single Mac Studio and cooldown policy shared by complete cells
result.repetition_policy: one observed run per task in the cell
result.evaluator: SWE-bench patch evaluation invoked by the pinned repository's eval/score_sweep.py path; exact external evaluator package revision is not stated in the pinned result artifact
result.execution_environment: benchmark-controlled local llama-server/proxy on one Mac Studio; quant-specific server load shared across harness cells; 120-second between-cell cooldown
result.adaptation_reset_policy: benchmark task worktree is materialized and released per task; persistent harness-side adaptation outside that worktree is not established

observations.notes: Exact upstream Claude Code version remains unknown. Claude Code is invoked with the benchmark wrapper's explicit tool/MCP restrictions and a 40-turn HarnessConfig cap in addition to the shared 1800-second task timeout; W1 records those facts without deciding later comparison eligibility.
